matches.rationale: GT1 concerns a mismatch between whisker array dimensions (5×7 with zero padding vs. anatomical coordinates without zero padding) in the Method section. None of the findings address whisker array configuration or spatial layout inconsistencies; they focus on Mamba characterization, neural correlation claims, and decoding accuracy statistics.

GT2 concerns missing equation numbers and undefined variables (specifically y_t^ℓ) in the IntersectionRNN update equations in Appendix A2.2. None of the findings address the appendix equations, variable definitions, or reproducibility issues in the IntersectionRNN formulation; they focus on different methodological and results inconsistencies.
